title: Small Ones First
statement:
A linked list is stored in `n` numbered nodes. Node `i` holds the value `v_i` and points to node `nxt_i` (`0` means no next node). The list starts at node `head` and passes through all `n` nodes exactly once.

Rearrange the list so that all nodes with a value smaller than `x` come first, followed by all the other nodes. Inside each of the two groups the nodes keep the order they had in the original list. If the values of the new list are `y_1 ... y_n`, print `(1*y_1 + 2*y_2 + ... + n*y_n) mod 1000000007`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`, `head` and `x`. The second line contains `v_1 ... v_n`. The third line contains `nxt_1 ... nxt_n`.

## Output
Print the value described above.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 13000`
- `0 <= v_i, x <= 10^6`
